mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_audit_event (execution_id, user_id, conversation_id, event_type, tool_name, args_digest, sensitive_flag, success, reason, span_type, span_index) VALUES (#{executionId}, #{userId}, #{conversationId}, #{eventType}, #{toolName}, #{argsDigest}, #{sensitive}, #{success}, #{reason}, #{spanType}, #{spanIndex})
mapper.select: SELECT id, execution_id, user_id, conversation_id, event_type, tool_name, args_digest, sensitive_flag AS sensitive, success, reason, span_type, span_index, created_at FROM agent_audit_event WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND sensitive_flag = 1 ORDER BY id ASC
